items.title: Apna course samjho
items.detail: Ye course kyun, ye university kyun, aur baad mein kya. Do line mein bol pao.

items.title: Funding clear rakho
items.detail: Kharcha kaun uthayega aur kaise. Uske documents haath mein rakho.

items.title: Honest raho
items.detail: Jo sach hai wahi bolo. Kuch nahi pata toh seedha bolo, kahani mat banao.

items.title: Documents order mein
items.detail: Ek folder, sahi sequence. Jo maanga jaaye, wahi do.

youtube.title: Visa interview aa raha hai? Ye 4 cheezein ready rakho
youtube.description:
Visa interview se pehle ye 4 cheezein ready rakho: apna course aur university kyun chuni, funding ka clear plan aur documents, honest jawab, aur documents ek folder mein sahi order mein.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
